set.body:
Current remaining work

Sequential assessment 2026-09-12: preserve P1 and existing doing/ownership as active PHRF program work; do not interpret it as proof a build process is currently running. Current build.sbt still pins Gale83, and docs/plans/profile-hrf-banded-spd-evidence.md plus the retained consumer patch explicitly record failed immutable-pin admission due to mixed sibling Gale source/artifact versions. The provider merge/CI is documented historical handoff evidence, not newly rechecked remote state in this assessment. Remaining native work is coordinated sibling pin/artifact alignment, effective-classpath proof of one Gale implementation, immutable ScalaFIM pin and affected JVM/JS/full compile qualification. Do not duplicate the already implemented banded solver, suppress dependency conflicts or call local overrides pinned admission. Preserve the existing agent handoff and the original complexity/conditioning/numerical requirements. This prerequisite remains central to PHRF-07 and therefore must not be deferred as optional provider integration.

Original acceptance

Owner: Gale, via PHRF-26. Acceptance:

- Gale gains packed banded SPD Cholesky, in-place and multi-RHS solves,
  transpose solves, log-determinant and conditioning diagnostics on JVM and
  JS, with laws in Gale's own suites.
- `galeRevision` bumped; scalafim consumers pass on both platforms.

Performance rule: `O(N b^2)` factor, `O(N b)` per-RHS solve, measured in
Gale's benchmarks.

Revision 2 (2026-09-10): docs/plans/profile-hrf-work-items-v2.md; review: docs/plans/profile-hrf-review.md; spike evidence: docs/plans/profile-hrf-spike-results.md; scientific plan: docs/plans/profile-hrf.md.
set.title: PHRF-06: Align sibling Gale dependencies and qualify the merged banded SPD provider
